scope: Separate instrumented Java 17 JMH diagnostic JVM: whole recording includes JVM/framework startup, setup, two 1-second warmup iterations, two 1-second measurement iterations, harness and teardown. No phase filtering. CPU execution sampling requests a 10ms period; allocation uses profile.jfc defaults. Recording and exported stacks retain up to 64 frames. These are not headline timings, framework-exclusive CPU, retained heap, exact object counts, p99 latency or RSS measurements.
